title: SEBI's New MF-Only PMS: A ₹25 Lakh Gateway to Managed Funds
description: SEBI has proposed a new category of Portfolio Management Services (PMS) that will exclusively invest in mutual funds. This "MF-only PMS" aims to bridge the ga.

faq.a: An MF-only PMS is a proposed Portfolio Management Service by SEBI that will exclusively invest in mutual fund schemes, rather than directly in stocks or bonds. It aims to provide professional portfolio management with a lower entry threshold.

faq.q: What is the minimum investment for MF-only PMS?
faq.a: The proposed minimum investment amount for an MF-only PMS is ₹25 lakhs. This is significantly lower than the ₹50 lakhs required for traditional PMS.

faq.q: How does the fee structure work for MF-only PMS?
faq.a: Investors in an MF-only PMS will typically pay two layers of fees: a management fee to the PMS provider for their services, and the expense ratios of the underlying mutual funds chosen by the PMS manager.

faq.q: Can NRIs invest in MF-only PMS?
faq.a: Yes, Non-Resident Indians (NRIs), especially those based in the Gulf, are typically eligible to invest in SEBI-regulated investment products like PMS, subject to specific regulatory guidelines and KYC requirements.

faq.q: Is MF-only PMS suitable for all investors?
faq.a: MF-only PMS is best suited for investors who have an investable corpus of ₹25 lakhs or more, prefer professional management of their mutual fund portfolio, and are comfortable with the layered fee structure. It's a bridge between self-managed mutual funds and traditional PMS.

faq.q: What are the key advantages of MF-only PMS over direct mutual fund investing?
faq.a: The primary advantages include professional expertise in fund selection and asset allocation, continuous portfolio monitoring and rebalancing, and potential for better risk-adjusted returns due to expert management, especially for investors lacking time or specific knowledge.
